\newpage

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(brms)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidybayes)
library(flextable)

# -----------------------------
# 1. FIXED EFFECTS
# -----------------------------

fixed_tab <- fit.null |>
  spread_draws(b_Intercept,
               b_egg_number_within,
               b_egg_number_between) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
               names_to = "term",
               values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    term = recode(term,
                  b_Intercept = "Intercept",
                  b_egg_number_within = "Egg number (within female)",
                  b_egg_number_between = "Egg number (between female)"),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter = term, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

fixed_ft <- flextable(fixed_tab) |>
  set_caption("Table S1. Fixed effects from Bayesian mixed model predicting mean egg size.") |>
  autofit()

fixed_ft


# -----------------------------
# 2. RANDOM INTERCEPT (ID)
# -----------------------------

random_tab <- fit.null |>
  spread_draws(sd_id__Intercept) |>
  median_qi(sd_id__Intercept, .width = 0.95) |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = "SD (Intercept | Female ID)",
    Estimate = round(sd_id__Intercept, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

random_ft <- flextable(random_tab) |>
  set_caption("Table S2. Random intercept variance (female ID).") |>
  autofit()

random_ft


# -----------------------------
# 3. RESIDUAL VARIANCE
# -----------------------------

sigma_tab <- fit.null |>
  spread_draws(sigma) |>
  median_qi(sigma, .width = 0.95) |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = "Residual SD (sigma)",
    Estimate = round(sigma, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

sigma_ft <- flextable(sigma_tab) |>
  set_caption("Table S3. Residual variance parameter.") |>
  autofit()

sigma_ft
```
